claims.sentence: It is now generally accepted that an intake of at least 250 mg EPA and DHA per day is required for optimal nutrition [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ], although the exact intake required for specific populations or health conditions is not known and in many cases is likely to be in excess of this suggested minimum intake.
